name: AI Film Studio
description: Plan shots, generate or source assets, assemble a sequence, and export a finished video.
licensing: Clear footage, music, likenesses and model weights before reuse. Local tools can avoid hosted API charges. Hardware, licensed assets and optional cloud services may still cost money.

steps.notes: Analyze footage you have permission to use. Carry the VIDEO.md timing notes into a shot list. Start with Python and FFmpeg installed.
Use a compatible local ComfyUI model if you need generated frames or footage. Match clips to the intended frame rate and verify the model and media terms.
Create HTML compositions using the shot list and locally stored assets. Local rendering uses Node.js 22+, Chrome and FFmpeg. Verify frame sizes, durations and audio sync.
Use FFmpeg and ffprobe to verify codecs, duration, tracks and target delivery settings. Confirm the chosen FFmpeg build's redistribution terms.
